title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.24338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference-time decoding methods improve LLM reasoning by exploring multiple candidate trajectories, yet treat each trajectory as atomic: either retaining it whole or discarding it irreversibly. This wastes computation on partially promising candidates whose high-quality prefixes are abandoned alongside degraded suffixes. We introduce Selective Regenerative Decoding (SRD), which routes each candidate to discard, keep, or refine only the degraded portion of the suffix while preserving the useful prefix of borderline candidates, without requiring a larger target model. Under mild assumptions, SRD achieves a provable 1.28-to-1.36-fold gain in sample efficiency over rejection sampling with strictly higher expected trajectory quality, with the gain growing as the candidate pool grows. translated_title: 选择性再生解码：推理时推理的轨迹级干预
translated_abstract: 推理时解码方法通过探索多个候选轨迹来提升LLM推理能力，但将每个轨迹视为原子操作：要么完整保留，要么不可逆地丢弃。这浪费了部分有前景候选的计算资源，这些候选的高质量前缀与退化后缀一同被舍弃。我们引入了选择性再生解码（SRD），该方法将每个候选路由至丢弃、保留或仅精炼后缀的退化部分，同时保留边缘候选的有用前缀，且无需更大的目标模型。在温和假设下，SRD在拒绝采样中实现了可证明的1.28至1.36倍样本效率提升，且期望轨迹质量严格更高，随着候选池增大，增益也随之增长。在MATH500、GPQA Diamond、HotpotQA和AlpacaEval上，使用多组生成-奖励模型对，SRD在显著减少生成次数的情况下匹配了Best-of-N的准确性。
tldr: SRD通过仅精炼退化后缀而非整体丢弃候选轨迹，在无需更大模型下实现了推理时解码的样本效率提升，并匹配了Best-of-N的准确性。
en_tdlr: SRD improves inference-time decoding sample efficiency by refining only degraded suffixes instead of discarding entire candidate trajectories, matching Best-of-N accuracy without requiring larger models.
